history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 62‑year‑old male who suffered an acute NSTEMI on 2023‑08‑06, followed by documentation of a history of myocardial infarction on 2023‑08‑08. In the preceding weeks he was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes (2023‑07‑31, A1c 6.7%), metabolic syndrome, and continues to have longstanding hyperlipidemia, hypertension (treated with amlodipine/benazepril), obesity (BMI >30) and anemia. He reports chronic neck and low‑back pain managed with ibuprofen and Percocet. Socially, he is currently not in the labor force and his housing is deemed unsatisfactory. He has been seen frequently for wellness visits but recent vital signs and laboratory data (BP, lipids, eGFR) are missing. His medication list includes antiplatelet therapy, a statin, antihypertensive, metformin, vitamin B12, and analgesics, with duplicate simvastatin entries and no beta‑blocker or P2Y12 inhibitor documented.
